command: VITE_TERMINAL_SMOKE_BUILD=1 pnpm tauri build --debug --no-bundle && pnpm smoke:local-cold-start -- --app-path $PWD/src-tauri/target/debug/terminal (invoked 3 times, one measured run per invocation)

measurement.probe: Rust TERMINAL_SHELL_PROBE marker written only after the frontend sent its nonce through xterm -> session_write -> local PTY and read the marker back

source.note: Computed over FINGERPRINT_PATHS by scripts/check-verification-evidence.mjs on the checked-out CI sources at evidence build time.

limitations: This binary is a VITE_TERMINAL_SMOKE_BUILD=1 pnpm tauri build --debug --no-bundle artifact with an embedded frontend; a plain build has no smoke/probe entry points and the runners refuse it.
The marker proves the local PTY round-trip is usable, not that a remote host answers: remote readiness is measured separately in 2026-10-11-macos-remote-shell-prompt-rerun.json.
Measured on a GitHub-hosted macOS virtual machine, not on a developer laptop or shipping hardware.
Human physical keyboard typing, IME composition, sleep/resume on a real lid close and Windows/Pageant/serial hardware are still not covered by this file.
